create_informer_prediction_model: create an InformerForPrediction model for probabilistic time-series forecasting with past and future values
build_informer_encoder_decoder: build an InformerModel with encoder-decoder architecture for seq2seq time-series prediction
run_informer_generate: run greedy sequence generation from InformerForPrediction to sample future time-series values
